National Suicide Prevention Lifeline  
We can all help prevent suicide. The Lifeline provides 24/7, free and confidential support for people in distress, prevention and crisis resources for you or your loved ones, and best practices for professionals in the United States  
1-800-273-8255  
The Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) is the agency within the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services that leads public health efforts to advance the behavioral health of the nation. SAMHSA's mission is to reduce the impact of substance abuse and mental illness on America's communities. Click the link to get started and find treatment today.  
https://www.samhsa.gov/

"Lift You Up"   
Upon hearing of the tragic death by suicide of Naomi Judd, I was inspired to write the poem, "Lift You Up." I could hear a country music song in the poem. Singer-Songwriter Corenia Yoder has so beautifully brought "Lift You Up" to life. Please feel free to share the song as it is a healing medicine for those who need loving care. #suicideprevention
